highlights: Rotary: line, cut and fill moves now run at the layer speed on the part, so text and outlines burn evenly all the way round. Rotary projects from 1.0.30 or earlier may burn darker or lighter; images are unchanged.

Rotary Setup adds Tapered part for tumblers and a choice of Y, A or Z axis. Job Review checks rotary image rows against the motor steps, and rotary camera placement advice now fits the axis that turns the part.

Camera: a picture at a new resolution is checked before it's placed, the calibration grade covers the whole bed, the moved-camera warning catches turns and tips, and the calibration target keeps Absolute Coordinates.
Camera Print and Cut checks which way round the printed sheet lies against the print. Camera logins now stay out of process lists, saved files and plain-text requests.

A glowing Update button at the top of the window downloads and installs a new version in two clicks, and waits while a job runs. The G-code Inspector's Run also asks if 1.0.29 set your laser up as a CNC.
CNC relief cut-outs report the real thickness of their holding tabs and warn when tabs are thin, roughed-only reliefs step down, and the box generator adds lift-off lid and open-front boxes.
